title: Banned From ts

replies.author: shadowolfyt
replies.body:
Hello There!
I banned you for sending an IP to a server that you encouraged other players to join and play. In theory, this is taking people away from Avicus and going to go and play your 'server'. This is classified under the category of Advertising.
You've done this on many occasions and have been punished before by another staff member.

In judgment of making this punishment, I looked back at the guidelines and from that, you have done this before.

"If possible could you send me the rules for use of your team speak server."
If I knew where the TeamSpeak rules were I would, I only have a copy of the Punishment Guidelines ;-;

I shall leave this open for your comment.
If you can reply here...

replies.author: shadowolfyt
replies.body:
Doesn't really matter if it was a temporary server or a permanent server.
If you see people posting IPs to other servers then please contact a staff member and we can look into it :)
I understand that you were warned from another staff member and you've continued.

Because this punishment is valid your temporary ban will stay in place.
I'll see you 4th April
I'll leave this open for further comment
